reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Supporting Uganda's Response to HIV - Uganda (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Uganda, HIV, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development of the Republic of Uganda (MoFPED)This program has the following goals: Increase productivity, inclusiveness and wellbeing of population through ending HIV and AIDS as an epidemic by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To reduce the number of youth and adult HIV infections by 65% and paediatric HIV infections by 95% by 2025. To reduce HIV related morbidity and mortality and contribute to preventing new HIV infections by 2025. To strengthen social and economic protection to reduce vulnerability to HIV and AIDS and mitigation of its impact on PLHIV, OVC, key populations and other vulnerable groups. To strengthen the multi-sectoral HIV and AIDS service delivery system that ensures sustainable access of efficient and quality services to all targeted populations. To strengthen the national HIV and AIDS strategic information management system for improved effectiveness and efficiency. Strengthen the health system to adequately respond to the next pandemic. Strengthen the health system to adequately respond to the next pandemic

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for UGA-H-MoFPEDP03
Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for UGA-H-MoFPEDP03
Percentage of adolescent girls and young women reached with HIV prevention programs- defined package of services
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Outcome indicators targets and results for UGA-H-MoFPEDP03
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed
Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period
